description: Invesco Ltd., along with its consolidated entities, is an independent investment management firm dedicated to delivering a superior investment experience, with a comprehensive range of active, passive and alternative investment capabilities constructed over many years to help clients achieve their investment objectives, drawing on this range of capabilities to provide solutions designed to deliver key outcomes aligned to client needs. With approximately 7,500 employees and an on-the-ground presence in more than 20 countries it is well positioned to meet the needs of investors across the globe, and it has specialized investment teams managing investments across a broad range of asset classes, investment styles and geographies, with a significant presence in the retail and institutional markets within the investment management industry in the Americas, Europe and Asia. Its strategy seeks to drive sustainable profitable growth by delivering capabilities that build enduring relationships and create better outcomes for its clients, and it believes it has an advantageous position globally as a diversified, client-centric asset manager.
